about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: We are passionate about design, events, and the intersection of both. Afisha was born out of a desire to preserve the fleeting magic of live events through beautifully crafted posters.

section2.title: Crafting Memories
section2.p1: Every poster we sell is carefully curated. We work directly with organizers and designers to bring you exclusive, high-quality prints that capture the essence of the events you love.
section2.p2: From local indie gigs to international conferences, we believe every great event deserves great art.

items.a: Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days within Uzbekistan. International shipping can take up to 14 business days.

items.q: What paper quality do you use?
items.a: We print on 250gsm premium matte paper with archival inks, ensuring your poster lasts for years without fading.

items.q: Can I return a poster if I don't like it?
items.a: Yes! We have a 14-day return policy for items in their original condition. Please note that return shipping costs are covered by the customer.
Currently, we offer standard A4, A3, and A2 sizes for most of our posters. For bulk or special requests, please contact our support team.
